ranking_scale.policy: Harmonic-analysis relevance and importance dominate the first section; importance and novelty dominate general mathematics. Scores are editorial component judgments, not mathematical proof verification.

ranking_audit.title: Curved Kakeya problems and the projective geometry of paths
ranking_audit.reason: A structural framework connects curved Kakeya incidence geometry, projective flatness, and oscillatory-integral path families.

ranking_audit.title: The Endpoint Eigenfunction Bound for the Hermite Operator in Two Dimensions
ranking_audit.reason: The claimed optimal two-dimensional endpoint closes the remaining Hermite spectral-projection case.

ranking_audit.title: The HRT Conjecture for Symmetric Configurations and Real-Valued Functions
ranking_audit.reason: It advances a central time-frequency linear-independence conjecture for infinite symmetric families and real-valued four-point configurations.

ranking_audit.title: Local smoothing for rough wave equations
ranking_audit.reason: Sharp local smoothing in low dimensions is extended to rough coefficients through adapted bilinear restriction and decoupling.

ranking_audit.title: Almost everywhere convergence of Mock Fourier series for the standard middle-fourth Cantor measure with respect to its canonical spectrum
ranking_audit.reason: A weak-(1,1) maximal theorem yields almost-everywhere convergence for a canonical singular spectral measure.

ranking_audit.title: Weak geometric lemma for ADR boundary of a uniform domain implies uniform rectifiability
ranking_audit.reason: The geometric criterion is directly relevant to quantitative rectifiability and harmonic measure.

ranking_audit.title: Pólya's Conjecture for the Neumann Laplacian on Euclidean Balls
ranking_audit.reason: A sharp spectral-counting conjecture for Neumann eigenvalues on balls has strong spectral-analysis interest.

ranking_audit.title: Fuglede's conjecture holds for three intervals
ranking_audit.reason: The three-interval case advances the spectral-set/tiling correspondence in one dimension.

ranking_audit.title: The Winding Number at the Critical Hölder Exponent 1/3: Failure of Universal Fourier Summation
ranking_audit.reason: A critical-regularity obstruction clarifies the limits of universal Fourier summation for winding number.

ranking_audit.title: Counterexamples to the Landis conjecture in dimensions three and higher
ranking_audit.reason: The construction bears on a major unique-continuation threshold in elliptic PDE.

ranking_audit.title: Multi-Parameter Exponential Sums with Product Hilbert Kernels
ranking_audit.discovery_source: arXiv API harmonic-analysis category/date and version sweep
ranking_audit.reason: The paper treats genuinely multi-parameter oscillatory sums with singular product kernels.

ranking_audit.title: Nonconcentration of eigenfunctions in Microlocal Kakeya-Nikodym norms: a phase space approach
ranking_audit.reason: Phase-space nonconcentration estimates link eigenfunction bounds with microlocal Kakeya-Nikodym geometry.

ranking_audit.title: An antichain approach to a conjecture of Zygmund
ranking_audit.reason: The combinatorial antichain method addresses a classical Zygmund problem in harmonic analysis.

ranking_audit.title: Dual boundedness of the maximal operator on concave Banach function spaces
ranking_audit.reason: It develops maximal-operator duality in a broad Banach-function-space setting.

ranking_audit.title: Localized frames on Euclidean balls
ranking_audit.reason: Localized frames on balls contribute constructive harmonic-analysis tools for bounded Euclidean domains.

ranking_audit.title: Knapp-type obstructions in multilinear fractal Fourier extension

event.revision_note: v3 incorporated referee comments and added examples

ranking_audit.reason: The substantial v3 revision sharpens and illustrates obstruction mechanisms in multilinear fractal extension.

ranking_audit.title: Favard length and generalized projections
ranking_audit.reason: Generalized projection estimates extend a core geometric-measure problem around Favard length.

ranking_audit.title: Hausdorff type Time-Trace Observability for Airy Equations on the Line and Point Observability on the Torus
ranking_audit.reason: Airy observability connects dispersive estimates, time traces, and thin-set geometry.

ranking_audit.title: On the Frequency Function of Hardy-Littlewood Maximal Functions
ranking_audit.discovery_source: Crossref Works API followed by the publisher version of record

identifiers.journal: Journal of Fourier Analysis and Applications

ranking_audit.reason: A verified version-of-record publication concerns structural frequency behavior of the Hardy-Littlewood maximal function.

ranking_audit.title: The Hardy averaging operator between Orlicz spaces and a new gauge functional characterizing a given Orlicz space
ranking_audit.reason: The operator-theoretic characterization is substantively within real-variable harmonic analysis.

ranking_audit.title: Counterexamples to the Jacobian conjecture in dimensions greater than two

event.context: The antecedent dimension-three announcement was July 19 and outside this window.

ranking_audit.reason: An extraordinary claimed extension of recently announced counterexamples to every complex dimension above two; ranked with an explicit unrefereed-claim caveat.

ranking_audit.title: On the Kähler MMP and the transcendental base-point-free theorem
ranking_audit.reason: The claimed Kähler minimal-model program and transcendental base-point-free theorem would supply broad birational-geometric infrastructure.

ranking_audit.title: Quantum Steenrod powers and Hamiltonian maps
ranking_audit.reason: Quantum operations yield several geometric and dynamical consequences, including uniruledness and periodic-point criteria.

ranking_audit.title: Area-minimizing submanifolds are not generically smooth, except for geodesics, minimal surfaces, and minimal hypersurfaces
ranking_audit.discovery_source: arXiv API all-mathematics date and version sweep
ranking_audit.reason: The work identifies a sharp-looking divide in generic regularity for area minimizers across dimensions and codimensions.

ranking_audit.title: Stability conditions and moduli spaces on projective families
ranking_audit.reason: A family-level theory of stability conditions and moduli spaces has broad reach in algebraic geometry.

ranking_audit.title: Proof of the Landau-Pekar formula for the effective mass of the polaron at strong coupling
ranking_audit.discovery_source: OpenAlex physical-sciences date/domain scan followed by DOI resolution and the publisher version of record
ranking_audit.reason: The reporting-window event is a verified Inventiones publication of a major strong-coupling asymptotic result.

ranking_audit.title: Range convergence and sharp one-arm asymptotics for the critical percolation cluster in high dimensions
ranking_audit.reason: Sharp one-arm asymptotics and range convergence address central high-dimensional critical-percolation scaling questions.

ranking_audit.title: The KLS constant is $O(\log^{1/4} n)$
ranking_audit.reason: The claimed logarithmic-exponent improvement is of high interest in asymptotic convex geometry, with confidence moderated for a first-version preprint.
